| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Window size** `size` | 5 | 3 to 9, odd px | Width and height of the square window for the median and the MAD. |
| **Threshold t** `t` | 3 | 0.5 to 10 | How many times the robust scale S a value may be from the median. |
| **Show** `output` | Repaired image | Repaired image, Outliers | Replace outliers by the median, or show white where any channel is an outlier. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
